project_type: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS frontend, Python + FastAPI backend, SQLite (stdlib), Windows dev environment
build_system: Backend: pip + uvicorn (no Makefile). Frontend: Vite 5 with npm. No monorepo tooling.
test_framework: Backend: pytest 8.3.3 with pytest-asyncio 0.23.8, asyncio_mode=auto set in backend/pytest.ini. Frontend: no test framework configured — build success is the only frontend check.
build_command: Frontend: cd 'c:\WiFi security analyzer\wifi-lan-security-analyzer\frontend' && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Backend tests: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v — must show all passing. 2. Frontend build: cd frontend && npm run build — must exit 0. 3. Import smoke test: cd backend && python -c 'from app.main import app; print(OK)' — must print OK.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/data/analyzer.db is generated at runtime — already in .gitignore per README. frontend/dist/ is the build output, not committed. backend/.pytest_cache/ not committed.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Workspace root: c:\WiFi security analyzer\wifi-lan-security-analyzer. All file paths must be absolute or computed relative to __file__ inside Python modules to work regardless of CWD. Do NOT use shell=True anywhere. Never restart the dev server — tests use ASGITransport, not a live server.
contribution_requirements: Rule 1-10 from original request: inspect before changing, reuse existing functionality, do not recreate from scratch, do not replace real scanning with mocks, do not remove/rename existing routes, preserve dashboard/sidebar/nav/Module 1 features, make changes incrementally, test after each major phase.
key_patterns: Backend routes: all under /api prefix, registered in main.py via include_router. Tests mock nmap at 'app.services.nmap_service.nmap.PortScanner'. DB calls must be wrapped in try/except in nmap_service.py so existing tests pass without a live DB. Pydantic v2 style (field_validator with @classmethod). Frontend: api.js exports get/post; scanService.js calls api.js. Components: Badge (variants: green/yellow/red/gray/blue), Button (primary/secondary/danger), Card, Table (columns+data+emptyMessage), PageHeader, LoadingSpinner, ErrorMessage. Table column render(value, row) receives both the cell value and the full row object.
directory_structure: wifi-lan-security-analyzer/ — project root with README.md. backend/ — Python FastAPI app. backend/app/ — application code (main.py + api/ + database/ + schemas/ + services/). backend/tests/ — pytest tests. backend/data/ — runtime SQLite DB location (gitkeep only in source). frontend/ — React+Vite app. frontend/src/ — all source: App.jsx, main.jsx, index.css; pages/, components/, hooks/, services/, layouts/. .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts (this directory).
